pages.title: Spirit Wood Tree
pages.text: $(bold)Natural habitat: $()Spiritwood Grove. Six tree attempts per chunk, with a 20% chance of two extra attempts. Suitable ground and space are required.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Spirit Wood Trees arise where wood essence gathers into secluded groves. Their trunks and leaves carry spiritual energy. Natural trees and vein-fed saplings grow in Spiritwood Groves; saplings can also be collected and planted.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Look for Spiritwood Groves among temperate forests in newly generated Overworld terrain. /locate biome immortal_cultivation_mod:spiritwood_grove can locate one.
